title: KTPro
wikitext:
'''KTPro''' used to be the most widespread QuakeWorld server mod for [[DeathMatch]] competition.  However, because it is closed-source currently in the hands of [[rxr]] (and is therefore slow to fix/develop), an open-source duplicate alternative called [[KTX]] has been developed that has been adopted fairly widely.
